main_text.p: vel oculo prodere: In sublimi veritas est, ascendere illis fas est (quod olim Leo & Gelasius) nobis descendere nec tutum, nec vero honestum: Quàm illud inprimis nimium constat, Ecclesiam Romanam, à primigenia Religionis puritate longius deflexisse. Nihilo certius est Romam vrbem à suis collibus ad vallem Martiam descendisse, aut Ethnicos olim (referente Eusebio) Veneris templo, sacrum Christi tumulum polluisse: Quanta hic nubes testium, etiam suorum? Vel à fœminis ordiamur; Hildegardis monacha non obscuri nominis Prophetissa, Epist. ad Euseb. Bell.cit.l.3.de Laici.Euf.hist.l.3. c.25.Ann. 1170.

page.notes: Marginal notes in the left column read: "Epist. ad Euseb. Bell.cit.l.3.de Laici."; "Euf.hist.l.3. c.25."; "Ann. 1170." The word at the foot, "extinctæ", is the start of the next line, so it is treated as a catchword; the paragraph itself continues from the previous page. Some letters in the margin notes are doubtful.
